name: Veran
title: Sentinel of the Evenway
examine: Old blood, whole: moonpale, upswept ears, a bow that was strung before the roads were roads. He keeps the mile the way other people keep a promise.
lines: The deadfall is cleared by morning. You are welcome, and it was not for you.
The lamps stop at the fork. That is not the road failing. That is the road handing over.
You are walking toward the city. Most who pass here are walking away from something instead. Both are allowed.
